verdict.rationale: Bento documents attaching user_id, session_id and tags to every span via init() [23], and tagging spans with experiment IDs, feature flags or other metadata [22]. It also groups runs by convo_id [24] and reports cost per run out of the box [10]. However, no evidence shows cost or usage being aggregated or broken down by those metadata dimensions, so attribution is only implied by combining tagging with per-run cost. Missing for 10: documented cost/usage rollups by user, session, or feature tag; token-level usage attribution; independent or hands-on corroboration.
